description: This file defines the implementation of the Stop task for the WebAudio component, which involves changing the pipeline state to null to stop audio playback.

classes.name: Stop
classes.description: A class representing the task to stop WebAudio playback by setting the pipeline state to null.

methods.name: Stop::Stop
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the Stop task with a reference to the WebAudio player.

methods.name: Stop::execute
methods.description: Executes the stop operation by changing the pipeline state to null.
